notes.title: Ghost Town OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33026102/eba459f2841cf402f4f6b0b0854568a7692be3fd.jpg[/img]

The wait is finally over! [u][b]GHOST TOWN IS OUT NOW[/b][/u] on Steam with a 10% launch discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2496180/Ghost_Town/

We've been hard at work crafting Ghost Town over the past 4 years(!) so we're super excited to get it in to your hands & to hear what you think of it.

We hope you enjoy exploring the world of Ghost Town!

- Fireproof Games

notes.title: THE ROOM VR: A DARK MATTER PRICE REDUCTION
notes.content:

notes.title: Ghost Town Update & Big Fireproof Sale!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280431/5dc73919ba3243ceb896dc79951b8cea3f687b31.jpg[/img]

Hello there!

It's been a while, so we figured a couple of update are in order!

[h1]Ghost Town - Meta Quest Store launch[/h1]
We've been keeping busy since our initial announcement last October getting Ghost Town all polished up for it's Meta Quest store release, which happened last Thursday!

The reception has been wonderful to see, with critic and player reviews almost unanimously positive so far. We've been glued to our screens waiting on every new video, review or comment to come through!

[url=https://www.uploadvr.com/ghost-town-vr-review/]Upload VR[/url] put together a particularly glowing piece if anyone fancies a bit of further reading!

[h1]Ghost Town - Steam release coming soon[/h1]
Now that Ghost Town has released on Quest we're focussing our attention on the PC (Steam) & PSVR2 versions. We don't quite have a date in the calendar that we can share yet, however as soon as we're confident on a launch day we'll let you know!

Wishlist below to keep on top of any new updates -
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2496180/Ghost_Town/?curator_clanid=33026102

[h1]Fireproof Games Sale![/h1]
In celebration of the Ghost Town's Meta launch, we're running a 2 week sale, which is live NOW, on all of our other games! This sale is the biggest we've ever done across all our title so if you were looking to grab one now's the time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/288160/The_Room/?curator_clanid=33026102
https://store.steampowered.com/app/425580/The_Room_Two/?curator_clanid=33026102

That's all for now! We'll be back once we have news on Ghost Town's steam release date [i]OR [/i]if we have anything else exciting to share!

notes.title: The Room: Old Sins - Coming to Steam February 11th!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33026102/8c1ed9667eabf0d9b275f73406ba5c9ac11c9323.jpg[/img]

We're delighted to announce that The Room 4: Old Sins is coming to Steam on February 11th 2021! With release exactly one month away we'd love you to spread the word and add the game to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1361320/The_Room_4_Old_Sins/

Since first releasing The Room 4: Old Sins on mobile and tablet devices back in 2017 there have been [i]countless requests[/i] for a PC version. Over the past year, despite a few disruptions here and there, we've created something we're incredibly proud of!

As with all our PC remasters, The Room 4: Old Sins has received a complete visual overhaul. Assets and environments have been completely re-built, re-textured and re-lit to bring the mysterious world of The Room to life.

We're super excited to share this game with you all next month. It's been a difficult year for everyone around the world, so we hope this announcement can act as a glimmer of good news! 

- Fireproof Games Team

notes.title: The Room VR: A Dark Matter - RELEASE TOMORROW!!
notes.content:
The Room VR: A Dark Matter is available on Steam as of [b]tomorrow[/b]! We're all set to hit the release button and can't wait to get it in to your headsets!

If you didn't know already - our Coming Soon Page is live now and from tomorrow, this is where you can purchase the game:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1104380/The_Room_VR_A_Dark_Matter/

Though this isn't our first venture in to VR, it is the first time The Room series has received this treatment. The game has been specifically built from the ground up to make the most of what VR has to offer and it really does feel like a natural fit for the series. We're super proud of how it's turned out!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33026102/8e44cc8b6e791a2f95245eb8e5a9f55589293793.jpg[/img]

After 18 months or so in development, we hope you're as excited to play the game as we are to release it!

- Fireproof Games Team

notes.title: The Room Three - RELEASE TOMORROW!!
notes.content:
The Room Three is available on Steam as of tomorrow! We're all set to hit the release button and can't wait to get it in to your hands!

If you didn't know already - our Coming Soon Page is live now and from tomorrow, this is where you can purchase the game:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/456750/The_Room_Three

The Room Three has received a complete visual overhaul for PC. As the game is significantly larger than the others in the series, this was quite an undertaking! Check out our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LPEkMcjeOgg]comparison video[/url] to get a glimpse of how every asset and environment has been re-built, re-textured and re-lit to bring the mysterious world of The Room to life.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33026102/b326270ff1aab4209b92a47a13634dc3e4f2b963.jpg[/img]
Continuing the story from The Room Two, your obsessive search for the Null results with being lured to ‘Grey Holm’, a mysterious mansion located on a remote island. You'll need all your puzzle-solving abilities on hand to navigate a series of trials devised by a mysterious figure known only as “The Craftsman”.

Grey Holm is home to many secrets, some of which may help you to alter your fate. It's up to you to discover them...

- Fireproof Games Team
